parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: This is the spherical part of the globe made of plastic, representing the Earth with printed maps and geographical details.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main display surface showing continents, countries, and oceans. It can rotate around its axis to simulate Earth's rotation.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate freely around the supporting axis attached to the base.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the globe, made of plastic, providing structural support and stability to the sphere.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the rotating sphere in place and ensures the globe remains upright and balanced on a flat surface.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal use.
